product.name: FuzeRx
product.description: An API-powered digital pharmacy solution for prescription fulfillment, patient intake, medication delivery, adherence support, and patient engagement.

product.name: Fuze Services Clinical Programs
product.description: Integrated clinical programs for preventive care, screening, functional assessment, post-discharge support, medication adherence, and chronic condition management.

product.name: Diagnostics and Health Screening
product.description: Scalable diagnostic testing and health-screening services that provide timely information about patient conditions and risks.

product.name: Genomics Services
product.description: Genetic screening, genome sequencing, and interpretation services that support early detection, preventive care, diagnosis, and personalized treatment decisions.

product.name: Fuze Technologies
product.description: Healthcare software and technology solutions for clinical enablement, remote-device programs, patient engagement, data analysis, and partner-platform enhancement.

product.name: Analytical Capabilities
product.description: Population analytics software that measures engagement, supports predictive modeling, and enables risk stratification across healthcare programs.
